$comment: End-to-end business workflows for issue #1 [E01]. Each step names the owning module so no agent has to guess responsibilities.

workflows.name: Sale
workflows.plain: Sell something and give the customer a bill
workflows.trigger: A user types, speaks or scans a sale instruction, or an approved quotation is converted.

steps.output: Draft sale request with a confidence score for every extracted field.
rules: Low-confidence party, item, quantity, unit or price is confirmed with the user, never assumed.

steps.output: Party id, item ids, units, HSN/SAC, tax profile.
rules: Two similar names must be disambiguated by the user.
An unknown customer is created only after the user confirms the details.

steps.output: Rate with its source, discount authority check, credit-limit decision (allow, warn, block).
rules: The price source is always shown.
Credit uses outstanding plus pending transactions.

steps.output: Reservation or a shortage block.
rules: Availability is physical minus reserved.
Overselling requires an authorised override with a reason.

steps.output: Tax lines with place of supply, rate, CGST/SGST/UTGST/IGST split, cess and the rule version used.
rules: A missing place-of-supply fact blocks the sale and opens an exception item.
An LLM never chooses the rate.

steps.step: Show a preview and take approval
steps.output: Approval decision recorded with actor and time.
rules: Preview repeats customer, quantity, unit, price, tax basis and stock impact in plain words.

steps.output: Permanent invoice number, immutable invoice record.
rules: Numbering is unique per company, branch and financial year and is concurrency safe.
The same idempotency key never creates a second invoice.

steps.output: Balanced SALE voucher: customer debit, income credit, output tax credit, round-off.
rules: The voucher must balance to zero or nothing is written.

steps.output: Stock movements out, reservation consumed.
rules: Ledger posting and stock posting succeed or fail together.

steps.output: IRN and signed QR, or a clearly failed state.
rules: Retries must not create a second IRN.

steps.step: Create the e-way bill if applicable
steps.output: E-way bill number and validity, or a documented not-required decision.
rules: Applicability is a deterministic rule decision with evidence.

steps.output: PDF or print output and a delivery record.
rules: Mandatory legal fields cannot be removed by any template.

steps.output: Open receivable with due date and ageing bucket.

failureModes.behaviour: Block with the exact shortfall and offer reduce quantity, choose another warehouse, or authorised override.
Move to the exception queue; never post a guessed tax split.
Invoice stays FINAL and correct in the books; the government step shows a retryable failed state.
The idempotency key returns the original invoice.

workflows.name: Purchase
workflows.plain: Record a supplier's bill, add stock and record what you owe

steps.output: Captured document with extracted fields and confidence.
Validation result, duplicate verdict, supplier GSTIN check.
rules: A suspected duplicate is never posted silently.

steps.step: Match to purchase order and goods receipt
steps.output: Three-way match result with tolerances.
Approval record.
PURCHASE voucher: purchases debit, input tax debit, supplier credit; stock movements in.
rules: Increases stock and creates a payable; it never creates a sale or a receivable.

steps.output: Credit marked provisional until it appears in GSTR-2B.

failureModes.case: Same supplier invoice number arrives twice
failureModes.behaviour: Blocked as duplicate with a link to the existing record.

failureModes.case: Bill total does not match line totals
failureModes.behaviour: Exception item; the difference is shown, never absorbed.

workflows.name: Return
workflows.plain: Goods come back, or a bill has to be reduced

steps.output: Linked original invoice and returnable quantities.
rules: Return quantity can never exceed the original quantity less earlier returns.

steps.output: Tax reversal lines using the original invoice's rule version.
rules: A return uses the tax treatment effective for the original supply.

steps.output: Credit note for a sales return, debit note for a purchase return.
CREDIT_NOTE or DEBIT_NOTE voucher plus reversing stock movements.
rules: Party balance, tax and stock all move together or not at all.

failureModes.behaviour: The note is dated in the current open period and linked to the original document.
A value-only note is issued with no stock movement, and this is stated on the note.

workflows.name: Payment
workflows.plain: Money comes in from a customer or goes out to a supplier

steps.output: Receipt or payment with mode: cash, cheque, bank transfer, UPI, other.
rules: Cheques start as PENDING and are not treated as cleared money.

steps.output: Allocation lines per invoice; the remainder stays on account.
rules: Partial payment never marks an invoice paid.
Unallocated money is visible, not assumed.

steps.output: RECEIPT or PAYMENT voucher.
Recomputed outstanding and ageing buckets.
rules: Outstanding equals invoice value less accepted allocations.

failureModes.behaviour: Post a reversal, restore the outstanding, keep the full cheque history, and notify.

failureModes.case: Customer pays more than the bills
failureModes.behaviour: Excess is held on account, not silently written off.

workflows.name: Banking
workflows.plain: Match your bank statement with your books

steps.output: Normalised bank lines.
rules: Re-importing the same file must not double-count lines.

steps.output: Suggested links to receipts, payments and invoices with confidence.
rules: A suggestion is never posted without confirmation.

steps.output: Confirmed reconciliation or a new voucher.
Reconciliation exception list.

failureModes.case: One bank credit covers three invoices
failureModes.behaviour: The user splits the allocation; the product does not choose.

steps.output: Append-only movement rows linked to a source document.
rules: Stock is always derived from movements; no balance is edited directly.

steps.output: Physical, reserved, available per item, warehouse and batch.
Transfer and adjustment documents with reasons.
rules: Every adjustment needs a reason and, above a threshold, an approval.

steps.output: Valuation postings using the configured method.
rules: The valuation method is fixed per company and changing it is an audited event.

failureModes.case: Two users sell the last 30 boxes at the same time
failureModes.behaviour: One succeeds; the other is blocked with the corrected availability.

failureModes.case: Backdated movement into a locked period
failureModes.behaviour: Blocked unless the period lock policy allows an audited override.

workflows.name: GST
workflows.plain: Work out and file your GST correctly

steps.output: HSN or SAC, rate, exemption or nil treatment, reverse-charge flag.
rules: Effective-dated tax data with a source reference.

steps.output: Place of supply and intra or inter-state conclusion.
rules: Unsupported scenarios are refused with an explanation, not approximated.

steps.output: GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B working papers with exception lists.
Matched, missing and mismatched credit lines.
rules: Credit is claimed only for eligible, reconciled lines.

steps.output: Filed acknowledgement stored against the tax period.
rules: Filing requires explicit human approval and is idempotent on retry.

failureModes.behaviour: Each invoice uses the rate effective on its own document date.
Credit is held as unavailable with the supplier and amount shown.

workflows.name: Transport
workflows.plain: Move the goods legally and safely

steps.output: Required or not required with the facts and rule version used.
Transporter id, vehicle number, mode, distance.
rules: An implausible vehicle for the load warns or blocks.

steps.output: Vehicle class and capacity check result.

steps.step: Generate, update and close the e-way bill
steps.output: E-way bill with validity, vehicle updates and closure.
rules: Retries must not create a second e-way bill.

failureModes.case: Two-wheeler entered for a multi-ton load
failureModes.behaviour: Warn or block with the capacity evidence.
Record a Part-B update against the same e-way bill.

workflows.name: Approval and exceptions
workflows.plain: A person checks anything risky before it happens

steps.output: Approval request with the reason and a plain-language preview.
rules: Thresholds are configuration, not code.

steps.output: What will change in books, stock, tax and money.
rules: The preview must be understandable without accounting training.

steps.output: Decision with actor, time and typed reason.
rules: The requester cannot approve their own request unless the company explicitly allows it.

steps.output: Append-only audit entry without secrets.

failureModes.behaviour: The item waits in a clearly visible queue; it is never auto-approved by time-out.
It enters the same approval path as manual entry, with no shortcut.
